Definition: from G2380; passion (as if breathing hard):--fierceness, indignation, wrath. Compare G5590.
BiblicalUsage: thymós is the word for passion, fierceness, wrath. In Luke 4:28, were filled with wrath. Across its 18 occurrences, the word keeps that same sense, whether the setting is promise or warning.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that wrath is not God losing control; it is His settled opposition to everything that destroys His people. That is why I hold thymós fast when easier words tempt me away.
